title: Trapping rain water
statement:
Given bar heights height (width 1 each), return how much rain water is trapped between them.

Constraints: up to 2 × 10⁴ bars. Aim for O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
hints: Water above bar i is min(max to the left, max to the right) − height[i].
Two pointers: the side with the smaller current bar is bounded by its own running max.

solution.explanation: Water at i is min(leftMax, rightMax) − h[i]. Prefix and suffix max arrays give O(n) time and space. Two pointers drop the arrays: if h[i] < h[j], the right side has a bar at least h[i]... more precisely, rightMax ≥ h[j] > h[i], so the water at i is decided by leftMax alone; add leftMax − h[i] and advance i, symmetrically for j.
